text:
alex: FYI starting staged rollout for inference-runtime v2.3.1 in the change window (02:00-04:00 UTC). canary 2% global, then 10% -> 25% over 2h if healthy.

alex: quick stop/go? release notes linked: https://internal/release-notes/2.3.1 — includes KV cache tweaks and a small batching heuristic change.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by @alex
Command: `/deploy start --service=inference-runtime --version=v2.3.1 --strategy=staged --steps=2%,10%,25% --window=02:00-04:00UTC`
Status: canary 2% started (tracked).

sara-dev: seeing a tiny spike in 5xx from eu-west-1 in the first 3 min, rate ~0.6% -> 1.8%. investigating. :eyes:

leo-sre: logs look like increased KV cache misses after first 10k requests in eu cluster. attaching snippet from our alert query: `sum(rate(infra_5xx_total[1m])) by (region)` 

leo-sre: might be related to the KV change in this release. recommend pausing EU expansion and pin EU to v2.3.0 until we triage.

tanya: +1 to pause EU. Can we keep other regions moving? we need to avoid cross-region blast radius.

michael-pm: product note — release notes call out improved cold-starts; if EU revert likely fine for short hold, want to know full rollback plan.

ops-jen: rollback plan: we can do a targeted traffic re-pin for eu-west-1 to v2.3.0 with the routing service; command below. expected propagation <90s.
```
# pin region to previous version
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing/pin \
  -d '{"service":"inference-runtime","region":"eu-west-1","version":"v2.3.0"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

ops-jen: fallback: if pin fails, we can abort rollout globally and trigger full rollback.

alex: vote check — tanya/leo/sara/michael/jen?

sara-dev: vote: pause EU and pin. continue global canary elsewhere.

leo-sre: vote: pin EU, continue others with metrics hold (watch 5xx, p50/p95 latency).

tanya: vote: pin EU. also want a short postmortem checklist if we find KV regression.

michael-pm: vote: pin EU. notify customers if we need extended hold >30m.

deploy-bot: Routing pin request submitted by @ops-jen for eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0. status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Routing pin completed (eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0). propagation confirmed to edge nodes.

alex: confirmed EU pinned back to v2.3.0. global canary continues at 2% in other regions, hold next step until healthcheck at +15m.

leo-sre: healthcheck window start now. watchlist: infra_5xx_total, kv_cache_miss_ratio, auth_errors. alert thresholds tightened for this window.

sara-dev: I'll run a quick A/B on the KV cache integration branch against traffic-replay for EU to reproduce. will share logs in 20m.

michael-pm: I'll update the release notes channel and ops pager with the hold and pin actions. small comms note: call out targeted rollback and that majority of users unaffected.

alex: thanks all. decision: hold EU -> repin to v2.3.0, continue cautious canary elsewhere, contingency = full abort/rollback if other regions show similar trend. re-open thread with findings. :white_check_mark:
